outcome: Fetal plasma essential amino acid concentrations
Placental gene expression of amino acid transporters (Slc38a1, Slc38a2, Slc38a4, Slc7a2, Slc7a5, Slc7a8, SNAT4, LAT2, SNAT1, LAT1, SNAT2)
cohort: Pregnant rats (n=8 per group) were fed either an isocaloric control (20% protein) or a low protein (4% protein) diet, either alone or supplemented with L-citrulline or L-arginine throughout gestation.
finding: Maternal supplementation with citrulline or arginine enhanced fetal growth in a rat model of IUGR by increasing fetal arginine availability and upregulating placental amino acid transporter gene expression, despite not restoring fetal essential amino acid concentrations.
birth_weight: Fetal weights ranged from approximately 4.01 to 4.48 grams.
